sources.title: OBD-II Telemetry – Opel Corsa 1.2 (2012)
sources.creator: PedroCuisinier2025
sources.capture: 2012 Opel Corsa 1.2 A12XER; ELM327 and python-OBD; city, suburban and highway driving.
cautions: TORQUE, POWER and GEAR are author-derived/estimated, not direct OBD sensor readings.
Low-rate road OBD data, not a high-frequency motorsport ECU log.
Do not interpolate asynchronous PID values or pass the irregular stream directly to the uniform-time FIR resampler.

Keep measured and theoretical values separate.
